exports: pub fn reserve(sink: &mut dyn ByteSink, additional: usize, limit: usize) -> Result<()>
pub fn append(sink: &mut dyn ByteSink, bytes: &[u8], limit: usize) -> Result<()>
impl ByteSink for VecSink: reserve, write_bytes, len
impl ByteSink for LimitedSink<'_>: reserve, write_bytes, len

test_vectors.name: free_reserve_only_assures_capacity_and_rechecks_current_length
test_vectors.vector: Existing ab, limit 5, repeated reserve(3), reserve(4), and reserve(0) with limit 1
test_vectors.expected: Repeated reservations preserve bytes and length; rejected limits do not delegate

test_vectors.name: free_append_writes_exact_binary_slice_once_after_reserving
test_vectors.vector: Bytes [0, 255, 34, 92], inclusive limit 4, empty append, then one extra byte
test_vectors.expected: Exact binary output, one reservation and write per successful append, excess rejected before delegation

test_vectors.name: free_helpers_reject_overflow_before_any_delegation
test_vectors.vector: Synthetic length usize::MAX, additional 1 and 0
test_vectors.expected: Overflow returns Encode/PayloadTooLarge; empty operations at the inclusive boundary succeed

test_vectors.name: free_helpers_preserve_errors_and_stop_after_reservation_failure
test_vectors.vector: Injected reservation and write errors with transport source and schema/field context
test_vectors.expected: Original error metadata retained; failed reservation prevents write

test_vectors.name: free_append_preserves_a_partial_external_write
test_vectors.vector: Starting length 7, four-byte write fails after appending two bytes
test_vectors.expected: Original external error retained and visible length remains 9

test_vectors.name: zero_limits_accept_only_empty_output
test_vectors.vector: Zero-limit VecSink and zero-limit LimitedSink over an existing prefix
test_vectors.expected: Empty reservations and writes succeed; nonempty operations fail without poisoning or changing bytes

test_vectors.name: vector_reservations_do_not_charge_subsequent_writes
test_vectors.vector: Limit 5, repeated reserve(5), append ab/cd/e, empty operations at capacity
test_vectors.expected: Output abcde reaches inclusive limit exactly without double charging reservations

test_vectors.name: vector_rejected_write_is_atomic_and_does_not_poison
test_vectors.vector: Limit 4, existing ab, rejected cde, accepted cd, reserve usize::MAX
test_vectors.expected: Rejected operations preserve bytes and capacity; subsequent bounded writes succeed

test_vectors.name: vector_capacity_overflow_is_deterministic_and_preserves_storage
test_vectors.vector: Limit usize::MAX, reserve isize::MAX + 1 with empty and nonempty vectors
test_vectors.expected: Encode/BudgetExhausted without huge allocation, unchanged bytes/capacity, later writes succeed

test_vectors.name: into_vec_transfers_the_original_allocation
test_vectors.vector: Reserve 16 bytes and write payload before ownership transfer
test_vectors.expected: Owned vector retains identical pointer, capacity, and bytes

test_vectors.name: limited_output_counts_only_new_bytes_and_preserves_prefix
test_vectors.vector: Existing prefix:, relative limit 3, repeated reservation and writes ab/c
test_vectors.expected: Relative len progresses 0/2/3, existing prefix retained, local excess remains recoverable

test_vectors.name: limited_limit_rejection_does_not_delegate_or_prevent_smaller_writes
test_vectors.vector: Relative limit 2, rejected three-byte requests, accepted a/b, overflowing reservation
test_vectors.expected: Local failures neither delegate nor poison; smaller writes remain possible

test_vectors.name: free_helpers_use_the_limited_sinks_relative_length
test_vectors.vector: Long existing prefix, wrapper limit 5, helper limits 3 then 5
test_vectors.expected: Helper accounting uses new output only and permits abcde independently of prefix size

test_vectors.name: nested_limits_count_output_since_each_wrapper_was_created
test_vectors.vector: Existing prefix, outer limit 5, outer a, nested limit 3 writes bcd, outer e
test_vectors.expected: Nested and outer accounting remain independent; final bytes are prefixabcde

test_vectors.name: limited_inner_errors_preserve_metadata_and_poison_both_operations
test_vectors.vector: Independent reserve/write failures without inner length changes
test_vectors.expected: First error preserved exactly; every subsequent reserve/write, including empty requests, returns Encode/InternalError without delegation

test_vectors.name: inner_limit_errors_poison_a_wrapper_even_when_the_write_was_atomic
test_vectors.vector: Inner limit 2 with existing a; wrapper limit 8 attempts bc
test_vectors.expected: Inner PayloadTooLarge preserved, bytes stay a, wrapper permanently poisoned

test_vectors.name: partial_inner_errors_are_preserved_without_fabricating_rollback
test_vectors.vector: Starting length 5; reserve fails after growth 1 or write fails after growth 2
test_vectors.expected: Original error takes precedence over length violations, prefix remains visible, wrapper is poisoned

test_vectors.name: successful_reservations_must_not_change_inner_length
test_vectors.vector: Inner reserve reports success after growing or shrinking by one byte
test_vectors.expected: Encode/InternalError and permanent poisoning, with no later delegation

test_vectors.name: successful_writes_must_append_exactly_the_requested_length
test_vectors.vector: Two-byte write reports success with growth 0, 1, or 3, or shrinkage 1
test_vectors.expected: Every incorrect length change returns Encode/InternalError and poisons the wrapper

test_vectors.name: even_empty_calls_enforce_inner_length_contracts
test_vectors.vector: Zero limit and empty reserve/write where inner incorrectly grows one byte
test_vectors.expected: Contract violation detected and wrapper poisoned even for empty requests

test_vectors.name: missing_existing_prefix_is_detected_before_delegation
test_vectors.vector: Cell-backed inner length decreases from 3 to 2 while borrowed; reserve and write paths
test_vectors.expected: Saturating public len remains zero, operation returns Encode/InternalError, no inner delegation

test_vectors.name: limited_arithmetic_checks_both_relative_and_absolute_lengths
test_vectors.vector: Synthetic prefix length usize::MAX - 1, unlimited relative budget, two-byte and one-byte requests
test_vectors.expected: Absolute and relative overflow rejected before delegation; final single byte reaches usize::MAX; empty requests succeed
